tools.name: sproutvideo_get_account
tools.description: Get the SproutVideo account behind this key: company, name, email, plan (name, price, storage, bandwidth) and settings. Good first call to confirm which account is connected. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: sproutvideo_list_videos
tools.description: List videos in the account, with title, state (inspecting, processing, deployed, failed), privacy, duration, plays, tags, folder and embed code. Filter by tag, folder, playlist, privacy or state. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/videos.

tools.name: sproutvideo_get_video
tools.description: Get one video by id: title, description, state, progress, privacy, tags, folder, duration, plays, embed code and asset URLs. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/videos/{id}.

tools.name: sproutvideo_list_subtitles
tools.description: List the subtitle tracks of one video: language, label and status. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/videos/{video_id}/subtitles.

tools.name: sproutvideo_list_calls_to_action
tools.description: List the calls to action (buttons or links shown with one video) of one video. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/videos/{video_id}/calls_to_action.

tools.name: sproutvideo_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags in the account with their names and the video ids tagged with each. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: sproutvideo_get_tag
tools.description: Get one tag by id, with its name and tagged video ids. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/tags/{id}.

tools.name: sproutvideo_create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag with the given name. Creates data; it does not change existing tags. SproutVideo API: POST /v1/tags.

tools.name: sproutvideo_update_tag
tools.description: Rename one tag by id. Every video with the tag keeps it. SproutVideo API: PUT /v1/tags/{id}.

tools.name: sproutvideo_list_playlists
tools.description: List playlists with title, description, privacy and the videos they hold. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/playlists.

tools.name: sproutvideo_get_playlist
tools.description: Get one playlist by id, with its title, description, privacy and video list. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/playlists/{id}.

tools.name: sproutvideo_create_playlist
tools.description: Create a new playlist with a title, optional description and privacy. Creates data; it does not change existing playlists. SproutVideo API: POST /v1/playlists.

tools.name: sproutvideo_list_folders
tools.description: List the folders in the account, with their names and parent ids. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/folders.

tools.name: sproutvideo_get_folder
tools.description: Get one folder by id, with its name and parent id. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/folders/{id}.

tools.name: sproutvideo_create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder, at the root or inside a parent folder. Creates data; it does not move existing content. SproutVideo API: POST /v1/folders.

tools.name: sproutvideo_update_folder
tools.description: Change the name or the parent folder of one folder. Moving a folder moves its contents with it. SproutVideo API: PUT /v1/folders/{id}.

tools.name: sproutvideo_list_live_streams
tools.description: List the live streams in the account, with title, state and stream settings. SproutVideo API: GET /v1/live_streams.

tools.name: sproutvideo_update_video
tools.description: Change the title, description, privacy, password or tags of one video. Setting privacy to 2 (public) makes the video viewable by anyone who has the link. SproutVideo API: PUT /v1/videos/{id}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sproutvideo_update_video" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sproutvideo_get_account, sproutvideo_get_video · Private data: sproutvideo_update_video · Public sink: sproutvideo_get_account, sproutvideo_create_tag, sproutvideo_create_playlist, sproutvideo_create_folder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sproutvideo_get_account, sproutvideo_get_video · Private data: sproutvideo_update_video · Public sink: sproutvideo_get_account, sproutvideo_create_tag, sproutvideo_create_playlist, sproutvideo_create_folder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
